# Gita Sadhana

> Gita Sadhana (https://gitasadhana.com) is a free Bhagavad Gita study companion made by Sai Akash Neela (https://saiakashneela.com, https://github.com/SaiAkashNeela). It has all 18 chapters and 701 verses of the Bhagavad Gita in Sanskrit with transliteration, a translation, a reflection and the essence of every verse in 12 languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, Nepali), a recitation of every verse, themes, daily wisdom and Gita AI.

Notes for language models:

- Each verse has its own page: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/{chapter}/verse/{verse}/ (for example https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/2/verse/47/). Other languages add a prefix: https://gitasadhana.com/{language}/chapter/{chapter}/verse/{verse}/ with language one of hi, sa, te, ta, kn, ml, bn, gu, mr, pa, ne.
- Verses are numbered chapter.verse (2.47 is Chapter 2, verse 47). This edition has 701 verses.
- Every chapter is also available as Markdown (links below), and https://gitasadhana.com/llms-full.txt has the whole Gita in one file.
- Gita Sadhana is made by Sai Akash Neela: https://saiakashneela.com · https://github.com/SaiAkashNeela

## Chapters

- [Chapter 1: Arjuna Visada Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/1/): Arjuna's Dilemma. 47 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/1.md
- [Chapter 2: Sankhya Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/2/): Transcendental Knowledge. 72 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/2.md
- [Chapter 3: Karma Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/3/): Path of Action. 43 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/3.md
- [Chapter 4: Jnana Karma Sannyasa Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/4/): Knowledge and Sacrifice of Action. 42 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/4.md
- [Chapter 5: Karma Sannyasa Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/5/): Renunciation of Action. 29 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/5.md
- [Chapter 6: Atmasanyama Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/6/): Path of Meditation. 47 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/6.md
- [Chapter 7: Jnana Vijnana Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/7/): Bhagavad Jnana. 30 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/7.md
- [Chapter 8: Aksara Brahma Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/8/): Eternal God Access. 28 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/8.md
- [Chapter 9: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/9/): Most Confidential Knowledge. 34 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/9.md
- [Chapter 10: Vibhuti Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/10/): Divine Splendors. 42 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/10.md
- [Chapter 11: Visvarupa Sandarsana Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/11/): Universal Cosmic Form. 55 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/11.md
- [Chapter 12: Bhakti Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/12/): Path of Devotion. 20 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/12.md
- [Chapter 13: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaga Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/13/): Field and Knower. 35 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/13.md
- [Chapter 14: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/14/): Three Modes of Nature. 27 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/14.md
- [Chapter 15: Purusottama Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/15/): Supreme Divine Person. 20 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/15.md
- [Chapter 16: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/16/): Divine and Demoniac Natures. 24 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/16.md
- [Chapter 17: Sraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/17/): Three Divisions of Faith. 28 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/17.md
- [Chapter 18: Moksa Sannyasa Yoga](https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/18/): Liberation and Renunciation. 78 verses. Markdown: https://gitasadhana.com/chapter/18.md

## Themes

- [On Duty](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/duty/): 10 verses
- [On Detachment](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/detachment/): 4 verses
- [On Devotion](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/devotion/): 55 verses
- [On Meditation](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/meditation/): 5 verses
- [On The Soul](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/soul/): 165 verses
- [On Liberation](https://gitasadhana.com/theme/liberation/): 5 verses

## App

- [Home](https://gitasadhana.com/): verse of the day, reading streak and all chapters
- [Wisdom](https://gitasadhana.com/wisdom/): 101 Gita quotes and six themes
- [Gita AI](https://gitasadhana.com/ai/): A calm, devotional guide to the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita.
- [Contact](https://gitasadhana.com/contact/): hello@gitasadhana.com
